0.

FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard ( First Revision ) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 15 March 1983, after the draft finalized by the Fire Fighting Sectional Committee had been approved by the Civil Engineering Division Council. 0.2 Water tender type `X' are used in replenishing the water of crash tender while engaged in fighting an aircraft fire SO that the fire fighting operations may continue longer without interruption. These are also used in town and rural areas where there is acute shortage of water. This in 1971 keeping in mind the larger standard was first published quantity requirement for water for fire fighting especially for air crash fire tenders and big city fire brigades. Since then number of changes have taken place. regarding the availability of chassis. Hence this is being modified to allow use of wider range of chassis. A list of accessories and equipment which do not form part of this appliance and most of which are normally required to assist in operation of the appliance is given in Appendix A for information and guidance. The appliance shall also conform to statutory rules in regard to height clearance framed by Transport Authority. 0.3 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in The number of significant places retained accordance with IS : 2-1960*. in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.
*Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revissd).

3. MATERIAL 3.1 The choice of material to be used in the construction of the appliance shall be made with a view to combining lightness with strength and durability. The following shall be followed:
a) Pump casing and impeller Aluminium alloy ( die cast ) according to IS : 617-1975" or lead tin bronze ( Grade LTB-2 of IS : 318-1981t) Lead tin bronze ( Grade LTB-2 of IS : 318-19817) for lead tin bronze pump and stainless steel ( Grade 04Cr18NilO of IS : 6603-1972: ) for aluminium alloy pump Stainless steel ( Grade 04Cr18NilO of IS : 6603-1972x )

4. DESIGN 4.1 Engine

4.1.1 The engine shall be provided with cooling system to permit its continuous stationary running without overheating. Indirect cooling system shall be incorporated, if necessary, which shall be of the open circuit type discharging water to the waste. Arrangements shall be made to divert the cooling discharge water to water tank, if necessary,

4.2 Electrical

42.1 A trickle type battery charger, if required, shall be provided for when the recharging the battery in situ. A red pilot lamp, indicating batteries are being charged from an external supply, shall be provided. electrical circuits shall have separate fuses, 4.2.2 All important suitably indicated and shall be grouped into a common fuse box located in an accessible position in driver's cab and fitted with means for carrying spare fuses. The wiring shall be single pole and shall not be exposed to the atmosphere. Conduits shall be used wherever necessary. 4.3 Water Tank - In case of rear mounted pump, single tank shall be used whereas in case of midship mounted pump, two tanks can be used The capacity of water tank shall be duly interconnected together. of 6 000 litres. 4.3.1 The tanker(s) of required capacity constructed out of mild steel, treated for anti-corrosion shall be suitably mounted on the chassis in a The manner keeping in view the proper load distribution on the axles. tank(s) shall be suitably baffled to prevent surge when the vehicle is brakThe baffles shall be arranged in a manner ing, cornering or accelerating. to facilitate the passage of a man throughout the tank for cleaning `The tank(s) shall be mounted on minimum of three cross purposes. members to counteract stresses caused by chassis flexing and shall be The tank body and baffles shall be so secured that it can be removed. minimum of 3 mm thick sheet except bottom which shall be 4 mm thick. 4.3.2 Suitable it to be lifted necessary. eyes shall be provided on the shell of the tank to enable off the vehicle for repairs/replacement as and when

4.3.3 The tank shall be fitted with not less than 2 over flow pipes of 75 mm or one overflow pipe of 100 mm diameter. The discharge and the overflow pipe shall be taken down below the chassis but without reducing Two 63 mm instantaneous hydrant connections the ground clearance. incorporating a strainer shall be provided close to the pump panel control for filling the tank through 50 mm bore pipe work or feeding the hose reel equipment. A 100 mm bore pipeline shall be taken from the tank to the suction inlet of the pump incorporating a 100 mm quick action spherical 6

type valve. Separate valves for performing the function given in 4.3.7 shall be provided to control the flow of water to the hose reel equipment. Drain plugs for drain cocks shall be provided, wherever necessary. 4.3.4 The tank shall be given adequate anti-corrosive treatment from inside after fabrication if it is not galvanised. Inside surface shall be prepared by sand blasting before painting. Epoxy treatment should be given inside the water tank for corrosion resistance. Epoxy treatment shall consist of one coat of primer with 2 coats of finish. Tank with its fitments shall withstand hydrostatic pressure of 0.3 bar. 4.3.5 Dial gauge water level indicator for the tank shall be provided preferably in the driver's cab or a visual level gauge of line glass tube shall be provided at the control panel calibrated l/4, l/2, 314 and full ( preferably calibrated in litres ). 4.3.6 The tank shall have a bolted manhole of minimum 45 cm A cleaning hole of at least 25 cm diameter, shall be provided diameter. at the bottom. 4.3.7 The tank shall be connected valve(s) shall be provided in such operations are possible: with the pump and hose reel and a way that any of the following

4.4.1 One hose reel shall be provided at the rear of the appliance with 60 m long of 20 mm bore hose connected by screw `C' type quick release couplings and terminating with a 8 mm shut off nozzle having 8 mm nozzle. The reel may be fitted with friction, brakes and locking device.
4.5 Pump

45.1 A centrifugal pump shall be preferably mountedof midship of the appliance. The pump may be either single or multi-stage type. Anti-friction bearings, external to the casing, be provided so as to avoid any bearings within the pump casing. The gland shall be of the mechanical self adjusting type. The impeller should be dynamically balanced. A drain cock plug shall be provided at the bottom of the casing. Studs

used in the pump casing shall be preferably of stainless steel. In case light alloy castings are used, these shall be of die-cast and without any blow holes, internal cracks, etc. The castings shall withstand the hydraulic pressure as givea in 4.5.4. 4.5.2 The pump shall be preferably completely covered. However, all The pump the controls on the panel and the gauges shall be uncovered. shall be coupled to the prime-mover of the chassis through a power-takeoff capable of full-torque of the engine used for the appliance. A control lever for engaging and disengaging the pump, with suitable locking devices shall be provided in the driver's cab. 4.5.3 The pump shall be designed to give its rated output of 3 200 litres per minute at 7 kgf,cm2 ( see Table 1 ) with an engine and pump input at The pump shall give shaft speed safe enough to operate the engine. performance as given in Table 1, when working with strainers ( except basket strainer ) at 27�C f 2�C.

The pump casing and impeller shall be subjected to a hydraulic pressure of 21 kgf/cm2 to detect leakage, perforation, etc. 4.6 Suction Inlet and Delivery Values

4.6.1 The pump shall have suction inlet(s) having 125 mm standard suction connection (sue IS : 902-1974* ) with internal strainer(s) The strainer(s) shall be retained firmly when in use and blank cap(s). but shall be easily removable. In case of midship mounted pumps, suction inlets shall be provided at each of two control panels. 4.6.2 The pump shall be provided with four delivery valves having 63 mm standard hose couplings (see IS : 903-19751_ ) with screwed wheel tvpe quick closing clack-valve ( see IS : 4928-1968$ ). Blank caps fastened &th chains and incorporating means to relieve pressure between the In the valve and the cap shall be provided one for each delivery valve. case of midship mounted pump, two delivery valves shall be provided at each panel. 4.7 Primer

4.7.1 The Primer shall be capable of lifting water at least 7-O m ( measured from water level to the centre of pump ) in not more than 24 seconds and shall preferably be fully automatic. The allowances shall be 30 cm for every 300 m elevation above mean sea level and one percent for 2*5"C rise in water temperature. 4.7.2 In the case of water ring type primer, means automatically disengage the primer when the pump required header tank complete with isolating valve solution is to be used in the circuit where necessary. the reciprocating type, means shall be provided to the speed of engine while the primer is engaged. shall be provided to is primed. 4.9 Body

Work

and

Stowage

4.9.1 Enclosed accommodation for six persons shall be provided in the driver cab-cum-crew compartment including the driver and the incharge of the crew. Two doors on each side shall be provided on the driver cabcum-crew compartment. The doors shall be hinged to open outwards and shall be hung forward and shall have catch-locks and flush type handles.
4.9.2 The cap and lockers shall be of metal construction with sufficient rigidity and reinforcement and shall be kept as light as possible. Pressed sections of sufficient strength shall be used for superstructure. 4.9.3 Lockers shall be provided to secure stowage of all equipment given in Appendix A except those mentioned at Sl No. 1, 25, 26 and 43. The height of the lockers from the bottom to the top of the opening shall be not less than 600 mm and depth not less than 600 mm. 4.9.4 All lockers shall be provided with internal automatic lighting arrangement with the master switch in the cab. The doors of the lockers shall have efficient means for holding them closed by efficient flush fitting The doors of the side lockers shall not be hinged at spring loaded locks. the bottom. 4.9.5 Hose tunnels shall be provided to carry four 2.5 m lengths of The tunnels should be sloped in suction hoses in convenient location. such a way that these allow the water/contents left in the hose after use to drain out. 4.9.6 Ladder Gallows - Gallows shall be provided to carry a 10.5 m The design shall be such that the ladder can be extension ladder. released without' difficulty from a reasonably accessible position and shall embody rollers to permit easy withdrawal by one man. Means shall also be provided for locking the ladder when stowed. 4.9.7 normal fitted recessed tray Tool Kit Container - A specially kit of tools, carried on the appliance, shall be provided. for the
